{{Otheruses|Sisters|more=Crimson}}
The '''Sisters of the Crimson Mark''' was an [[Aquar]] vigilante group formed and led by [[Vilhona]], which was opposed to [[Nexcore Mining Corporation]] operations on the planet [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]]. Their operations centered mostly around disrupting Nexcore, though they were also known to commit petty crimes to pay for their expenses.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
